description: Bulk-read every domain owned by an account: number of DNS records and DNSSEC status per zone. Useful for spot-checking large fleets.

account_id.description: Organization/account ID. Optional: defaults to the first account the token has access to.

filter_contains.description: Filter domains by substring (case-insensitive). Use this for targeted audits (e.g. 'broz.be') to avoid scanning the entire fleet.

max_domains.description: Cap the number of domains scanned. Each domain requires 2 sequential API calls (records + dnssec). Default 20 keeps execution under ~30s.

name: infomaniak_audit_dns_zones
